sourceRecords.title: Thundertree 7 · Venomfang’s tower
read: A broken tower rises above two spider corpses. The air around it smells sharp and wrong; the upper roof is open to the sky.

The dead spiders give the tower's sharp smell a more tangible companion. Broken stone and the open upper roof offer places to look before you approach the entrance. You can keep your distance, seek another view of the structure, or pause to decide what danger you are willing to meet.

brief: Interior of SAME round stone tower. SINGLE room with FORTY-foot ceiling, five-foot-wide staircase circles inner wall to half-open roof; heavy timber beams and stair supports cross overhead. ONE young GREEN dragon Venomfang occupies floor, neck alert, wings folded sufficiently for enclosed space. Modest broken wooden chest with scattered coins nearby, not a mountain of gold. No fire breath, extra dragon, wizard, exposed magical axe or dead player characters. Daylight from roof.
